params.label: Equator temperature
params.hint: Hottest band of the temperature field worldgen paints the biomes from.

params.label: Polar temperature
params.hint: Coldest band. Widen the span against the equator for sharper biome belts.

params.label: Temperate cut point
params.hint: Above this a tile leaves the temperate band. The sim owns the cut points.

params.label: River density
params.hint: Scales how many drainage channels survive into rivers.

params.label: Population growth rate
params.hint: Baseline per-turn growth before food and morale modifiers.

params.label: Temperature morale penalty
params.hint: Morale lost per degree outside the tolerance band.

params.label: Band work range
params.hint: How far from camp a crew may work a source.

params.label: Band move rate
params.hint: Tiles a band covers per turn when relocating.

params.label: Tile worker cap
params.hint: Most hands one tile holds across every band: keepers, builders and harvesters together.

params.label: Keep-on-hand refill
params.hint: Turns a keep-on-hand deficit is spread over: a band digging a mined material to its target works at its draw plus deficit / this.

params.label: Forage throughput
params.hint: Biomass one BARE-HANDED forager can take per turn. What a basket buys is on the item's own tier in equipment.json.

params.label: Forage conversion
params.hint: Wild baseline. A committed patch uses its own basket's rate instead.

params.label: Patch regrowth
params.hint: How fast a drawn-down patch climbs back toward its capacity.

params.label: Collapse threshold
params.hint: Share of capacity below which a patch starts collapsing.

params.label: Hunt haul (sledless)
params.hint: Biomass one SLEDLESS hunter can haul home per turn. What a sled buys is on the item's own tier in equipment.json.

params.label: Arrivals horizon
params.hint: How far the forward food projection looks ahead.

params.label: Per-capita food draw
params.hint: Baseline eaten per head per turn, before the cohort factors.

params.label: Birth rate
params.hint: Baseline births before reserve and food-trend modifiers.

params.label: Deficit birth penalty
params.hint: How hard a falling food trend suppresses births.

params.label: Starting food reserve
params.hint: Turns of larder a new band opens with. The early-game difficulty dial.

params.label: Travois pack multiplier
params.hint: What one worker's pack is multiplied by once the faction has learned Travois. 1.0 changes nothing.

params.label: Scout sight range
params.hint: Per-turn LOS radius a scouting party reveals WITH wayfinding gear. A party carrying none observes at the item's bare 6.

params.label: Party upkeep
params.hint: Per-turn drain while a scouting party is in the field.

params.label: Raid carry capacity
params.hint: Pack capacity per worker. Party size times this is one trip's haul.

params.label: New band worker floor
params.hint: Working-age people a new band must start with when a band splits. 1 turns the floor off and is still a real band.

params.label: Home band worker floor
params.hint: Workers the home band must keep after a split. 0 turns the floor off for a playtest run.

params.label: Party defection pull
params.hint: Pull a scouting party from an unhappy band must build up, watching a better-off people, before it joins them. Low: parties defect at first sight. High: they rarely do.

params.label: Independence grievance
params.hint: Grievance at which bands cut off from the heart of their people break away as a people of their own. Low: any far band with a bad season leaves once out of touch. High: only a starving band ever leaves.

params.label: Cohesion ceiling
params.hint: How many people one band can hold together with no belief where it stands. Above it the band's morale falls and people drift to a smaller band of their own. Low: bands fray early. High: bands grow large and stay whole.

params.label: Belief lift
params.hint: People a heavily honoured tile adds to the cohesion ceiling of a band standing on it. 0: belief holds nobody together. High: a sacred place keeps a very large band whole.

params.label: Belief half-lift
params.hint: Dead remembered on a tile at which it gives half its lift. Low: a few graves lift the ceiling. High: only an old burial ground does.

params.label: Cohesion drag
params.hint: Morale a band loses per turn for being twice its ceiling, less in proportion when nearer. 0: an oversized band never minds. High: it frays within a few turns.

params.label: Drive reach gain
params.hint: Extra animals a crew engages from a full herd once its people have learned drives. 0.5 is half again as many. 0 makes the skill do nothing.

params.label: Full drive herd size
params.hint: Herd size, in animals, at which a drive reaches its full gain. Low: even a small herd drives at full strength. High: only the great herds do.

params.label: Lethality
params.hint: Scales every side's losses in a resolved fight.

params.label: Disengage threshold
params.hint: A loser past this loss share is driven off rather than annihilated.

params.label: Expedition danger
params.hint: Extra lethality for a detached party. Never applied to a resident band.

params.label: Score memory
params.hint: How much of last turn's mobility score is kept each turn. High: the score remembers the long walking legs through the loiters between them. Low: it tracks this turn's walking.

params.label: Skills weight
params.hint: How much of the score is what the people have learned: herd lore, travois and drives. Keep it and the distance weight summing to 1 so the score stays on a 0-100 scale.

params.label: Distance weight
params.hint: How much of the score is the ground bands walked this turn following a herd, grazing or migrating. A people that stops roaming stops earning it.

params.label: Full-pace walk
params.hint: Hexes a band must step in one turn, following a herd (grazing or migrating), to earn the full distance points. Matches a band's walking speed, so walking every turn saturates it.

params.label: Points for a chief
params.hint: How many points a band must bank before it accepts a chief (or an elders' council). Once it has one it keeps it and the points stop counting.

params.label: Cultivate, Farm, Tame or Corral finished
params.hint: Points a band banks each time it finishes a Cultivate or a Tame.

params.label: Band split (each band)
params.hint: Points each of the two bands banks when you split a band: one organises what the leavers take, the other needs someone to lead it away.

params.label: Per hex following a herd
params.hint: Points a band banks for every hex it steps while following a herd, grazing or migrating.

params.label: Settlement stage reached
params.hint: Points a band banks the first time it grows into each settlement stage past the first. Each stage pays once.

params.label: Closeness for a tribe
params.hint: The closeness score two linked bands sharing an urn must reach to be a tribe (with a chief among them). Below it, they come apart.

params.label: People a chief runs well
params.hint: How many people one chief (or elders' council) runs well. Past it, orders still go out but less of each one is carried out.

params.label: Bands a paramount chief runs well
params.hint: How many member bands a paramount chief (or council of chiefs) runs well. Past it, orders are carried out worse.

params.label: Past-reach efficiency
params.hint: The share of each order carried out for the people or bands beyond a leader's reach. 1 means no penalty.

params.label: Shared origin
params.hint: Closeness two bands get for descending from the same starting band — a split from one another or from a common ancestor.

params.label: Culture likeness
params.hint: Closeness at identical culture, less as the two bands' cultures differ.

params.label: Knowing each other
params.hint: Closeness at a full tie between the two bands; the tie fades when they stop meeting.

params.label: Shared history
params.hint: Closeness at a full shared history of living local to each other.

params.label: Turns to build history
params.hint: Turns living local to each other for two bands' shared history to fill.

params.label: Turns to forget history
params.hint: Turns apart for a full shared history to be forgotten.

params.label: Belief on the shared urn
params.hint: Closeness from a strong sacred place; a little belief adds little.

params.label: Acting as a tribe
params.hint: Closeness a tribe gets from work done at the tribe level. No tribe-level work exists yet, so this has no effect until it does.

params.label: Monument at the urn
params.hint: Closeness two bands get while a monument stands kept on their shared urn.

params.label: Terrain morale allowance
params.hint: Attrition the gentlest ground carries without costing morale. Only a terrain's attrition above this drains morale each turn. 0: every terrain drains. High: rough ground stops mattering.

params.label: Fresh water morale
params.hint: Morale a band gains each turn standing on or beside fresh water — a river along its tile, a lake or marsh next door. 0: water does nothing for morale.
